account: The detect.restored_class criterion requires tests to detect when a subclass is returned instead of the exact InterpolationMissingOptionError. Current code uses assertIsInstance for deep copy and pickle, which accepts subclasses. Fix: change to assertIs(type(...), configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError) for both. Shallow copy already uses assertIs correctly. File: Lib/test/test_configparser.py, sha c26b26bc...
discussion: The tests check fails on detect.restored_class: the mutation returns a subclass instead of the exact InterpolationMissingOptionError class. My deep copy and pickle assertions use assertIsInstance, which passes for subclasses. I need to use assertIs(type(...), ...) for exact class checks on both deep copy and pickle round-trips.
